name: Biosciences PhD Programs
summary: One application covers Stanford's 14 Biosciences PhD programs across the School of Medicine and School of Humanities and Sciences.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: For Autumn 2027 entry. Late applications are not accepted.

timeline.interviews: Invitations go out from mid-January to mid-February. The single in-person interview session is March 3–6, 2027; some applicants abroad may be offered a virtual interview.
timeline.decisions: Applicants not invited to interview by mid-February are unlikely to be admitted.

english.note: Not required with a US degree or two or more consecutive years of full-time English-language study or work in the past 10 years. Lower scores (below TOEFL 5.5/109 or IELTS 8) mean taking Stanford's English Placement Test. Scores must be from 1 September 2024 or later.

applicationFee.note: Waivers prioritise US citizens and permanent residents; international applicants may apply for the school-based fee waiver.

documents: Statement of purpose (up to 2 single-spaced pages)
requirements.note: GRE General Test scores are not considered by any of the 14 programs.

funding.note: Students in good standing receive a stipend, tuition and health insurance. Stanford has a limited number of fellowships for the most competitive international applicants, and international admission varies with funding and space. It encourages applying for home-country scholarships too.

international.note: International admission varies from year to year depending on funding and available space.
